text:
Estadio BBVA fii adansie a ɛkɔɔ so fi 2011 kosi 2015 wɔ US$200 million, na ɛyɛɛ stadium a ɛyɛɛ den paa wɔ Mexico bere no mu. Wɔbuee no wɔ 2 August 2015, da a wɔyii sɛ ɛne C.F. Monterrey 70th anniversary no hyia. Populous ne Mexican firm VFO na wɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no, na Federico Velasco na ɔyɛ lead designer. Nea ɛbaa mu no wɔfrɛ no El Gigante de Acero, Steel Giant, din a ɛfata beaeɛ a ne grandstand kɔ 34 degrees na ne field-to-seat ntam yɛ FIFA minimum. Wɔ open northern end no, Cerro de la Silla mmepɔw no wɔ frame sɛ mfonini.

Wɔyɛɛ stadium no sɛ C.F. Monterrey, a wɔfrɛ no Rayados, fie, a wofi Estadio Tecnológico a ɛwɔ mfeɛ 63 mu baeɛ. FEMSA na ɛwɔ na ɛhwɛ so, na ɛyɛɛ adeɛ foforo wɔ Mexico akyi nso: ɛbɛyɛɛ football stadium a edi kan wɔ North America a ɛnya LEED Silver certification. Wɔ ne configuration a ɛtaa mu no, beaeɛ no tumi kura nnipa bɛyɛ 53,500, a general seats yɛ bɛyɛ 43,000, club seats yɛ bɛyɛ 5,000, na luxury suites yɛ 324, na akyerɛwee a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ 53,529. Wɔ 2026 World Cup mu no, beaeɛ no tumi kura 51,243 na ɛbɛkɔ agorɔ anan, a ɛyɛ mprɛ a edi kan a ɛbɛkɔ men's World Cup football.
